system_description.narrative_title: China reshapes global supply chains and regional security
system_description.narrative_summary: A single dominant narrative links economic policy, industrial push, and strategic activity by China that is remaking global supply chains, technology ecosystems, and regional security dynamics. News items show China expanding export production (autos, EVs, shipbuilding, components), deepening tech capabilities (AI, memory chips, listings), creating alternative trade routes (Arctic ‘Ice Silk Road’), and projecting military influence—provoking allied industrial responses, export controls, and security drills. The system is open: flows of goods, capital, technology and force interact with feedbacks from partner and rival states and multinational firms, producing rapid reconfiguration of markets and alliances.
system_description.scope: Inside the boundary: PRC economic and industrial policy, Chinese firms (autos, EVs, chips, AI, shipbuilding), trade routes and logistics (including Arctic initiatives), regional states (South Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Vietnam, Indonesia, Hong Kong), allied responses (US, EU policy and corporate moves), supply chains for semiconductors/automotive/marine/space, capital markets and listings, and military activities (naval/air drills, missile tests).
system_description.super_system: Global political-economic order (international trade, finance, technology regimes, and security architecture)
adjacent_subsystems: Global technology supply chains (semiconductors, memory, AI)
Indo-Pacific security architecture and military balance
Global automotive and manufacturing value chains

variables.name: Industrial production capacity
variables.description: The installed output potential of manufacturing sectors measured as producible goods per period given existing plants and equipment.

variables.name: Advanced technology capability
variables.description: Cumulative level of high-end technological know‑how, talent, and production capability in domains like microelectronics and AI.

variables.name: Manufacturing export flow
variables.description: The rate and volume of outbound shipments of manufactured goods across borders per unit time.

variables.name: Technology transfer flow
variables.description: The rate at which technical knowledge, designs, intellectual property, and production techniques move between jurisdictions and firms.

variables.name: Logistics route diversity
variables.description: The degree to which supply movements are distributed across multiple maritime, land and air corridors instead of concentrated chokepoints.

variables.name: Strategic military presence
variables.description: Scale, disposition and persistence of forward-deployed military assets and force-projection activities in a region.

variables.name: Defense operations tempo
variables.description: Frequency and intensity of military exercises, patrols, missile tests and related operational activities over time.

variables.name: Trade restriction level
variables.description: Aggregate intensity of export controls, tariffs, licensing rules and formal trade barriers affecting cross-border commerce.

variables.name: Investment capital flow
variables.description: Net cross-border flows of equity, debt and direct investment into industrial and technology sectors per unit time.

variables.name: Capital market accessibility
variables.description: Ease of access to equity and debt financing across jurisdictions, including listing access and investor openness.

variables.name: Supply chain resilience
variables.description: Ability of production systems to maintain output amid disruptions via inventory, substitution, and rerouting mechanisms.

variables.name: Geopolitical tension perception
variables.description: Collective perceived level of strategic threat and political friction among states and firms that influences cooperation and risk-taking.

variables.name: Supplier reorientation rate
variables.description: Speed at which firms change supplier relationships and relocate production across borders in response to incentives or risks.

variables.name: Technological ecosystem fragmentation
variables.description: Degree of divergence between regional technology standards, platforms, and compatible supply chains creating separate ecosystems.

variables.name: Energy and logistics costs
variables.description: Aggregate transport fuel, shipping and logistics cost levels that shape the economic viability of supply routes and production locations.

variables.name: Regulatory harmonization level
variables.description: Extent of alignment and mutual recognition of standards, certification regimes and regulatory rules across jurisdictions.

catalysts.title: US–South Korea joint military drills
catalysts.description: Planned US–South Korea exercises announced amid North Korean threats will raise regional operational activity and forward deployments.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'South Korea, US to conduct military drills amid evolving North Korea threats'; 'North Korea fires missile ahead of major US-South Korea drills'.

catalysts.title: Taiwan annual war games and communications throttling
catalysts.description: Taiwan's yearly exercises (including mobile internet throttling and coastal strike drills) will test readiness and resilience of regional networks and supply connectivity.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Taiwan simulates repelling Chinese assault... slow mobile internet'; 'Taiwan president oversees coastal strike drill during annual war games'.

catalysts.title: Planned China–Indonesia naval drills east of Taiwan
catalysts.description: Scheduled bilateral naval exercises in sensitive waters will increase regional deployments and political friction around Taiwan.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China, Indonesia navies to hold drills in sensitive waters to east of Taiwan'; 'Taiwan hits out at China over planned Chinese navy drill with Indonesia'.

catalysts.title: Expansion of China's 'Ice Silk Road' Arctic shipping
catalysts.description: China's Arctic shipping/routes initiative will progressively bypass traditional chokepoints, altering routing options and logistics costs for exporters.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China bypasses shipping chokepoints with ‘Ice Silk Road’ through Arctic'; 'China is winning the race for the Ice Silk Road'.

catalysts.title: South Korea semiconductor funds and industrial support
catalysts.description: Seeding of new funds for chips, materials and semiconductor hubs will accelerate investment and domestic supplier development.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'South Korea to launch $3.5 billion chip fund...'; 'South Korea to establish fund for semiconductor materials, parts and equipment'.

catalysts.title: Hanwha bid for Austal's US operations
catalysts.description: Hanwha's takeover offer for US shipbuilder assets could reconfigure naval shipbuilding capacity and foreign investment into defense manufacturing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Shipbuilder Austal gets $1.2 billion offer for US operations from Hanwha'; 'South Korean group makes US defence push with shipbuilding bid'.

catalysts.title: Ford shifts some Lincoln production from China to US (by 2030)
catalysts.description: Ford's announced plan to increase Lincoln production in the US implies a reallocation of manufacturing capacity and supplier relationships by 2030.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'EXCLUSIVE: Automaker Ford to move production of some Lincoln models from China to US'; 'Ford says it's increasing Lincoln production in the U.S. in 2030'.

catalysts.title: Surge in Chinese AI listings and domestic capital flows
catalysts.description: A wave of AI-related IPOs and listings in China will mobilize capital into domestic advanced-tech firms and deepen local ecosystems.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'The bank behind China’s AI listings bonanza'; 'Moonshot shake-up seeks to win Beijing nod for stock market debut'.

catalysts.title: Taiwan raises defence spending for 2027
catalysts.description: Taiwan's planned 16% rise in defence spending for 2027 will fund procurement and readiness, shifting regional defense dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Taiwan's 2027 defence spending to rise 16%, official media reports'.

catalysts.title: Apple testing Chinese CXMT memory chips
catalysts.description: Apple's evaluation of Chinese memory suppliers could shift high-end component sourcing and accelerate supplier integration into global devices.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Apple tests China's CXMT memory chips for iPhones and MacBooks'; 'Apple Tests Chinese Memory Chips as Supply Squeeze Bites'.
